title: May 10, 2024
segments: The book of Zachariah chapter 14 AND
VERSE 12. AND THIS SHALL BE THE PLAGUE
WHEREWITH THE LORD WILL SMITE ALL THE
PEOPLE THAT HAVE THAT HAVE FOUGHT
AGAINST JERUSALEM. SO, SOME OF Y'ALL
FIGHT against us. We teach you the word
of God and you fight against us. We are
Jerusalem. Jerusalem mean the city of
peace. We bringing peace to you right
now. We are the preachers of peace. It's
like Christ is the prince of peace.
That's right.
So, we come to bring you peace, good
tidings, wisdom, and you fight against
us. So, Christ said, "Everybody that
fight against Jerusalem, fight against
this word, fight against the prophets."
GO AHEAD.
THEIR FLESH SHALL CONSUME AWAY WHILE
THEY STAND UPON THEIR FEET. NOW, WHAT
GOT THE power to make your flesh consume
away while you still standing on your
feet? Think about what this is saying.
This is just like the movie The
Terminator. Where you see as the nuclear
blast came, you saw their skin falling
off of their body. You can see their
bones still standing. That's what God
say going to happen on this earth.
